source.title: Block Talk - epizoda #2 | Sve o Binance hacku, prognoze kretanja cijene bitcoina i druge aktualnosti

summary.title_hr: Block Talk - epizoda #2 | Sve o Binance hacku, prognoze kretanja cijene bitcoina i druge aktualnosti
summary.abstract_hr: U drugoj epizodi Block Talka Veljko Skenderija moderira razgovor s Vedranom Mijatovićem i Deanom Roguljom o hakerskom napadu na Binance. Napad pripisuju sjevernokorejskoj Lazarus grupi i u njemu je izvučeno između 6,3 i 6,4 milijarde dolara. Sudionici smatraju da je riječ o 'novom normalnom' i da sam napad neće gurnuti tržište u dublji bear market. Raspravljaju o ulozi centraliziranih izdavatelja stablecoina i decentraliziranog protokola Thorchain te o tome gdje čuvati kriptoimovinu. Razgovor zatim prelazi na negativan listopad, tehničku analizu Bitcoina s razinama podrške i otpora, dugoročne cjenovne prognoze te rast interesa za privacy coine.
key_points: Hakeri su, prema navodima, kompromitirali laptop jednog Binanceova inženjera i izvukli između 6,3 i 6,4 milijarde dolara. Vedran tvrdi da su sredstva korisnika sigurna jer hack čini tek oko 4 do 5 posto Binanceova zaštitnog fonda.

Vedran i Dean smatraju da ovaj događaj sam po sebi neće izazvati dublji bear market ni bank run. Dean ipak upozorava da bi otvaranje isplata moglo izazvati stres kod korisnika koji imaju račun samo na Binanceu.

Circle i Tether zamrznuli su oko 3 milijarde dolara u stablecoinima, a haker je dio sredstava konvertirao preko Thorchaina. Vedran podržava odluku Thorchaina da ne blokira swapove jer je riječ o decentraliziranom protokolu kojem bi za to trebao konsenzus sudionika.

Dean se ne slaže s izjavom Jeffa Kendricka iz Standard Chartereda da će ovakvi incidenti ubrzati prelazak na DEX-ove. Predviđa treću skupinu korisnika koja će kriptovalute kupovati i čuvati preko banaka.
Listopad će vjerojatno završiti s padom od nešto više od 7 posto, što je najgori rezultat od 2014. Vedran ne želi davati prognoze, ali smatra da Bitcoin načelno ide prema gore kao zreli asset.

Dean u tehničkoj analizi ističe podršku na oko 76 do 77 tisuća dolara (21-tjedna EMA), zatim na 72 do 74 tisuće i kao zadnju liniju obrane 65 do 67 tisuća dolara. Otpor vidi na 84 do 86 tisuća, a završetak godine u gornjim 90-ima odmah bi potpisao.

O privacy coinima Vedran smatra da interes potiču regulatorni pritisak (KYC) i potreba institucija za privatnim transakcijama, a Monero ocjenjuje kao najkompletniji. Zcash kritizira jer privatnost nije zadana postavka, a Dean kao dodatni razlog navodi otpor prema CBDC-ovima poput digitalnog eura.
key_points_en: Hackers reportedly compromised a Binance engineer's laptop and extracted between 6.3 and 6.4 billion dollars. Vedran claims that user funds are safe because the hack constitutes only about 4 to 5 percent of Binance's emergency fund.

Vedran and Dean believe that this event in itself will not trigger a deeper bear market or a bank run. Dean nevertheless warns that opening withdrawals could cause stress among users who only have an account on Binance.

Circle and Tether froze about 3 billion dollars in stablecoins, and the hacker converted part of the funds via Thorchain. Vedran supports Thorchain's decision not to block swaps because it is a decentralized protocol that would require participant consensus to do so.

Dean disagrees with the statement by Jeff Kendrick from Standard Chartered that such incidents will accelerate the shift to DEXs. He predicts a third group of users who will buy and store cryptocurrencies through banks.

October will likely end with a decline of just over 7 percent, which is the worst result since 2014. Vedran does not want to make forecasts, but believes that Bitcoin in principle moves upward as a mature asset.

In his technical analysis, Dean highlights support at around 76 to 77 thousand dollars (21-week EMA), then at 72 to 74 thousand, and as the last line of defense 65 to 67 thousand dollars. He sees resistance at 84 to 86 thousand, and he would immediately sign up for an end of the year in the upper 90s.

Regarding privacy coins, Vedran believes interest is driven by regulatory pressure (KYC) and the need of institutions for private transactions, rating Monero as the most complete. He criticizes Zcash because privacy is not the default setting, while Dean cites resistance to CBDCs like the digital euro as an additional reason.
summary.title_en: Block Talk - Episode #2 | All about the Binance hack, bitcoin price trend forecasts and other current events
summary.abstract_en: In the second episode of Block Talk, Veljko Skenderija moderates a conversation with Vedran Mijatović and Dean Rogulja about the hacker attack on Binance. The attack is attributed to the North Korean Lazarus Group, and between 6.3 and 6.4 billion dollars were extracted in it. The participants consider this to be the 'new normal' and that the attack itself will not push the market into a deeper bear market. They discuss the role of centralized stablecoin issuers and the decentralized Thorchain protocol, as well as where to store crypto assets. The conversation then moves to a negative October, technical analysis of Bitcoin with support and resistance levels, long-term price forecasts, and the growing interest in privacy coins.
